note: Fresh nationwide batch using audit-driven Solution A standards: high-fidelity surgical homepage cleanup prototypes tied to concrete audit findings. Parent and workers targeted gpt-5.5.

items.name: CR's Mobile Detailing Services
items.summary: Waynesville mobile detailing site has clear package intent and testimonials, but generic Wix copy, repeated package CTAs, and a buried quote path make a focused booking cleanup easy to demonstrate.

items.name: HandyMan At Your Service NC
items.summary: North Carolina handyman site has direct phone contact and service breadth, but duplicate generic CTAs, long template-style service text, and weak trust hierarchy create a strong estimate-flow cleanup pitch.

items.name: West Coast Mobile Detailing
items.summary: Medford mobile detailing page has real service and hours information, but dated copy, typo-heavy service descriptions, and a form-heavy contact flow weaken trust and booking clarity.

items.name: JC Mobile Detailing
items.summary: Detailing page shows bookable packages and pricing, but generic hero language, repeated price blocks, and a vague contact section make a cleaner service-to-booking path valuable.

items.name: R&R's Handyman Service's
items.summary: Handyman homepage has an estimate CTA and service imagery, but awkward punctuation, stock/service repetition, and generic section copy create obvious trust and scanability fixes.

items.name: Shark Mobile Detailing
items.summary: Dallas detailing site has local SEO terms and a phone number, but keyword-stuffed copy, thin service cards, and Wix footer residue are trust-damaging quick-win issues.

items.name: CYS Cleaning
items.summary: Cleaning service page includes detailed package pricing, but dense checklists, buried CTA structure, and service-page-first navigation make it hard to scan and request the right cleaning.

items.name: High Shine Mobile Detailing
items.summary: Sacramento mobile detailer has strong capabilities and contact info, but the homepage starts with mission copy, large dense service lists, and weak top-level booking hierarchy.

items.name: Pure Form Cleaning Group
items.summary: Cleaning group has bookable janitorial/residential services and pricing, but the page leans on generic Wix booking blocks, weak proof, and unclear buyer paths for residential vs construction vs janitorial leads.

items.name: S4L Personal Training & Coaching
items.summary: Marietta personal-training site has credentials, location, and offer hooks, but crowded typography, scattered program copy, and mixed CTAs obscure the best first session path.
